content: We need a Diels-Alder retrosynthetic template that when applied to the given molecule (COC([C@]12CC=CC[C@H]1C(C2)=O)=O) reproduces the reaction. The search gave some templates but not clearly Diels-Alder. We need template that forms two new C-C bonds from two C=C bonds. Likely template with bonds_formed ["6-6"] and bonds_broken ["6-6"] gave some results but not Diels-Alder. We need to find appropriate template ID and mapped_rxn. Could try search with functional_groups maybe none. But maybe Diels-Alder template is in database. Let's search with bonds_formed ["6-6","6-6"]? Actually two bonds formed. Use bonds_formed list with two entries? Might need both. Let's try search with bonds_formed ["6-6","6-6"], bonds_broken ["6-6","6-6"] limit 5.
